Protocol Information
From
Wikipedia
:
NDMP
, or
Network Data Management Protocol
, is a protocol meant to transport data between network attached storage (
NAS
) devices and
backup
devices. This removes the need for transporting the data through the backup server itself, thus enhancing speed and removing load from the backup server.
Default port:
10000
PORT      STATE SERVICE REASON  VERSION
10000/tcp open  ndmp    syn-ack Symantec/Veritas Backup Exec ndmp
Enumeration
nmap -n -sV --script "ndmp-fs-info or ndmp-version" -p 10000 <IP> #Both are default scripts
Shodan
ndmp
